threepl.simulator

Class SimRange

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.simulator.SimRange

  • public class SimRange
extends java.lang.Object
    A SimRange object contains two non-negative ints, the smaller being the low range linit and the larger being the high range limit. The numbers can be the same (single valued range). Ranges are used to specify array index ranges and bitranges.
    Version:
    $Revision: 6003 $
    Author:
    Andrew Tulloh
